result.summary: Take work order 1956543 (EXPANSION NETWORK, priority 0) first: open 19 working days against a 7-day target, 12 over. 283 open work orders (priority_level=0) carry 566.0 priority-weighted points as of 2026-09-08; past their SLA target: 1. The heaviest hot spot is asset_group=TOA within priority_level=0 with 99% of the weighted backlog; send crews there first.

claims.statement: Ranked first: work order 1956543 (EXPANSION NETWORK, 19 days open vs 7-day target); work order 1972786 (CONSTRUCTION INSPECTION, 5 days open vs 7-day target); work order 1968061 (SIGNWORKS JOB – CHILD (FABRICATION), 9 days open vs 36-day target).

asset_group=TOA within priority_level=0: 281 open order(s), 0 past target (0 once weather-impacted days are allowed for); the oldest has waited 9 working days. Start with work order 1968061 (SIGNWORKS JOB – CHILD (FABRICATION)), open 9 working days against a 36-day target.
283 open orders (100%) have no priority recorded, mostly SIGNWORKS JOB – CHILD (FABRICATION) (155 orders); they need triage before they can be ranked fairly.

In the closed historical sample, TOA orders that closed within 60 working days took a median of 2 working days (180 closed in the sample). The sample is too small to tell whether weather slows closures.
Ages count working days only: 1 public holiday(s) and 4 weather-impacted day(s) fall in the period; allowing for weather, overdue orders drop from 1 to 1.

priority_list.address: PENNSYLVANIA AVENUE SE AND MINNESOTA AVENUE SE

caveats: SLA targets: 2 of the 2 asset-group and priority cells used in this triage use the 75th percentile of closures within 60 working days from a sample of 289 closed historical orders; the rest are assumptions, and priority weights are assumptions. The sample is small, so treat targets as indicative, not DC policy.
Priority 5 is treated as the most urgent (EMERGENCY orders carry it in this extract); the source does not document the priority scale.
The data covers 3 August to 8 September 2026 only, and ages are measured to the last work order raised.
The ranking says where the weighted backlog and overdue work sit; it cannot see crew capacity, contracts or budgets, which are not in the data.
283 open orders (100%) have no priority; they are scored as medium urgency until someone triages them.
SAMPLE MODE: the weather table is SYNTHETIC test data, so weather figures are not real.

evidence.sql: SELECT MAX(initiated_date) AS as_of, MIN(initiated_date) AS first_day, COUNT(1) AS n FROM fixfirst.work_orders WHERE record_set = 'active_fy2026'

SELECT COALESCE(w.asset_group, '(none)') AS member, COUNT(1) AS n_orders, SUM(COALESCE(p.weight, 1)) AS points FROM fixfirst.work_orders w LEFT JOIN fixfirst.sla_policy p ON p.asset_group = w.asset_group AND p.priority_level = COALESCE(w.priority, 0) WHERE w.status IN ('OPEN', '01-ASSIGNED', '02-INPROGRESS', 'PENDING') GROUP BY COALESCE(w.asset_group, '(none)')

SELECT COALESCE(w.ward, '(none)') AS member, COUNT(1) AS n_orders, SUM(COALESCE(p.weight, 1)) AS points FROM fixfirst.work_orders w LEFT JOIN fixfirst.sla_policy p ON p.asset_group = w.asset_group AND p.priority_level = COALESCE(w.priority, 0) WHERE w.status IN ('OPEN', '01-ASSIGNED', '02-INPROGRESS', 'PENDING') GROUP BY COALESCE(w.ward, '(none)')

SELECT COALESCE(w.category, '(none)') AS member, COUNT(1) AS n_orders, SUM(COALESCE(p.weight, 1)) AS points FROM fixfirst.work_orders w LEFT JOIN fixfirst.sla_policy p ON p.asset_group = w.asset_group AND p.priority_level = COALESCE(w.priority, 0) WHERE w.status IN ('OPEN', '01-ASSIGNED', '02-INPROGRESS', 'PENDING') GROUP BY COALESCE(w.category, '(none)')

SELECT COALESCE(w.priority, 0) AS member, COUNT(1) AS n_orders, SUM(COALESCE(p.weight, 1)) AS points FROM fixfirst.work_orders w LEFT JOIN fixfirst.sla_policy p ON p.asset_group = w.asset_group AND p.priority_level = COALESCE(w.priority, 0) WHERE w.status IN ('OPEN', '01-ASSIGNED', '02-INPROGRESS', 'PENDING') GROUP BY COALESCE(w.priority, 0)

SELECT COALESCE(w.status, '(none)') AS member, COUNT(1) AS n_orders, SUM(COALESCE(p.weight, 1)) AS points FROM fixfirst.work_orders w LEFT JOIN fixfirst.sla_policy p ON p.asset_group = w.asset_group AND p.priority_level = COALESCE(w.priority, 0) WHERE w.status IN ('OPEN', '01-ASSIGNED', '02-INPROGRESS', 'PENDING') GROUP BY COALESCE(w.status, '(none)')
SELECT holiday_date, holiday_name FROM fixfirst.us_holidays ORDER BY holiday_date
SELECT weather_date, precip_mm, wind_max_kmh, temp_max_c, temp_min_c FROM fixfirst.weather_daily ORDER BY weather_date

SELECT w.asset_group AS asset_group, COALESCE(w.priority, 0) AS priority_level, w.initiated_date AS initiated_date, w.closed_date AS closed_date FROM fixfirst.work_orders w WHERE w.record_set = 'history_sample' AND w.closed_date IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(w.is_canceled, 'N') <> 'Y' ORDER BY w.work_order_id

SELECT COUNT(1) AS n_orders, SUM(COALESCE(p.weight, 1)) AS points FROM fixfirst.work_orders w LEFT JOIN fixfirst.sla_policy p ON p.asset_group = w.asset_group AND p.priority_level = COALESCE(w.priority, 0) WHERE w.status IN ('OPEN', '01-ASSIGNED', '02-INPROGRESS', 'PENDING') AND COALESCE(w.priority, 0) = 0

SELECT w.work_order_id AS work_order_id, w.description AS description, w.status AS status, w.initiated_date AS initiated_date, COALESCE(w.priority, 0) AS priority_level, w.category AS category, w.asset_group AS asset_group, w.ward AS ward, w.address AS address, w.latitude AS latitude, w.longitude AS longitude, p.target_days AS target_days, COALESCE(p.weight, 1) AS weight, p.target_basis AS target_basis FROM fixfirst.work_orders w LEFT JOIN fixfirst.sla_policy p ON p.asset_group = w.asset_group AND p.priority_level = COALESCE(w.priority, 0) WHERE w.status IN ('OPEN', '01-ASSIGNED', '02-INPROGRESS', 'PENDING') AND COALESCE(w.priority, 0) = 0 ORDER BY w.work_order_id

SELECT COALESCE(w.asset_group, '(none)') AS member, COUNT(1) AS n_orders, SUM(COALESCE(p.weight, 1)) AS points FROM fixfirst.work_orders w LEFT JOIN fixfirst.sla_policy p ON p.asset_group = w.asset_group AND p.priority_level = COALESCE(w.priority, 0) WHERE w.status IN ('OPEN', '01-ASSIGNED', '02-INPROGRESS', 'PENDING') AND COALESCE(w.priority, 0) = 0 GROUP BY COALESCE(w.asset_group, '(none)')

SELECT COALESCE(w.category, '(none)') AS member, COUNT(1) AS n_orders, SUM(COALESCE(p.weight, 1)) AS points FROM fixfirst.work_orders w LEFT JOIN fixfirst.sla_policy p ON p.asset_group = w.asset_group AND p.priority_level = COALESCE(w.priority, 0) WHERE w.status IN ('OPEN', '01-ASSIGNED', '02-INPROGRESS', 'PENDING') AND COALESCE(w.priority, 0) = 0 GROUP BY COALESCE(w.category, '(none)')

SELECT COALESCE(w.ward, '(none)') AS member, COUNT(1) AS n_orders, SUM(COALESCE(p.weight, 1)) AS points FROM fixfirst.work_orders w LEFT JOIN fixfirst.sla_policy p ON p.asset_group = w.asset_group AND p.priority_level = COALESCE(w.priority, 0) WHERE w.status IN ('OPEN', '01-ASSIGNED', '02-INPROGRESS', 'PENDING') AND COALESCE(w.priority, 0) = 0 GROUP BY COALESCE(w.ward, '(none)')

markovian.note: efficiency uses spec 6.3: standard cost replays every prior chunk; Markovian cost is steps x carryover_tokens + tokens used. It can be 0 for short chains.
